'''''Chains of Justice''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], part of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s fleet. It often paired with the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Venom]]''. It fought at the [[Battle of Selaggis]] to help protect Zsinj and his damaged flagship [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] but was forced to retreat when forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] destroyed the ''Venom''.

==Behind the scenes==
''Chains of Justice'' was introduced in [[Aaron Allston]]'s ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', the seventh book in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|X-wing series]]. It later received a brief entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].
